en: Crumble Dungeon (the daily score attack against the Holy Golden Drop)
note: The mode the user calls the Golden Drop attack stage. Found under Dungeon → Challenge Dungeon (도전 던전).
Not the pet 갓난갓방울 (Holy Baby Drop), which the gallery shortens to 갓방울, nor the pet 황금방울 (Gold Drop).

en: Challenge Dungeon (the Dungeon menu tab holding Crumble Dungeon, beside Daily Dungeon)
The first 40: the highest-power cookies that deploy first in Crumble Dungeon

note: Record 002 glosses the same beam as 빨대.

en: Levelling a cookie down (to reorder ATK or drop it out of the first 40)
'World line': a lucky run setup where Milk arrives on time
ATK order (the ranking that routes the beam and ATK-targeted perks)
note: Written as initials, e.g. 우브전피마치 = Milk, Brightseeker, Scorpion, Figure, Macaron, Cheesecake.

en: The title for holding the weekly Crumble Dungeon top 100 (literally 'golden radiance'; its official English name was not captured)
